summary: Verified the LLM settings bridge autostart fix with focused API regressions, the full Python suite, real local bridge provider listing outside the sandbox, web smoke startup, AppForge quality tools, and llm_bridge typecheck/tests.
test_commands: .venv/bin/python TestClient runtime probe for /api/llm/providers in sandbox
.venv/bin/python TestClient runtime probe for /api/llm/providers outside sandbox

results.evidence: tests/test_web.py passed 9 tests, including autostart retry, autostart guidance, and HTTP-error preservation cases.
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q passed 27 tests with one pre-existing Starlette TestClient deprecation warning.
Outside the command sandbox, a TestClient request to /api/llm/providers returned HTTP 200 and provider IDs openai, anthropic, google, openrouter, xai, deepseek, groq, cerebras.
The same runtime probe inside the sandbox failed with Operation not permitted / Bun listen failure, proving why the successful runtime check needed escalation rather than hiding the failure.
Outside the command sandbox, APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --smoke --no-open reached /api/health and / then stopped the web process.
appforge tool run run_tests executed .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q successfully.
appforge tool run run_build built sdist and wheel successfully; setuptools license deprecation warnings are pre-existing metadata warnings.
bun run typecheck completed tsc --noEmit and bun test passed the llm_bridge server test.

acceptance_results.evidence: The LLM settings API now starts the local bundled bridge on network-level connection failure and retries once, while preserving explicit launcher bridge behavior.
Autostart is restricted to http loopback hosts and does not manage remote bridge URLs.
Focused tests, full pytest, AppForge run_tests/run_build, llm_bridge typecheck/test, and outside-sandbox smoke completed with success.
Full Python test suite and package build passed after adding the new Python module and route retry wrapper.
Autostart writes llm-bridge.log under the configured runtime directory and shuts down only the process it started.
The process manager checks health, starts once under a lock, polls only until APPFORGE_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT, and returns actionable timeout/process-exit guidance.
Failed sandbox runtime checks were preserved as failures, then rerun outside sandbox to collect valid localhost evidence.

coverage: Verification covers the reported connection-refused class, the provider listing path used when the LLM settings dialog opens, failure guidance when autostart cannot run, preservation of bridge HTTP errors, full backend regression behavior, package build, local web smoke, and llm_bridge TypeScript/test health. A live external model call is intentionally not covered because it requires user credentials.
failures: Sandbox runtime probe failed with localhost Operation not permitted and Bun listen failure; this was rerun outside sandbox and passed.
Sandbox build.sh --smoke failed because uvicorn could not bind 127.0.0.1; the same command was rerun outside sandbox and passed.
AppForge run_build emitted pre-existing setuptools license metadata deprecation warnings while returning success.
manual_checks: Reviewed appforge/llm_bridge_process.py for loopback-only URL handling, no shell interpolation, bounded timeout, and launcher-owned process cleanup.
Reviewed appforge/web.py to confirm only status_code 0 BridgeError triggers autostart and retry.
Reviewed tests/test_web.py to confirm the regression assertions exercise behavior visible to /api/llm/* clients.
